claims.text: Lisinopril 10 mg is prescribed daily in the morning.
Home blood pressure readings are around 150/90 mmHg.
The note states lisinopril 'continues', implying it was started prior to 2026-08-15.

open_questions: When was lisinopril first started, and at what dose?
What was the initial blood pressure reading that led to lisinopril initiation or dose adjustment?
Has lisinopril been held, reduced, or increased before, and if so, when and why?
Are there any recorded home blood pressure readings prior to 2026-08-15, and what were the trends?
Was any other antihypertensive medication tried before or alongside lisinopril?
Is there documentation of renal function or potassium monitoring since starting lisinopril?
Which allergies or reactions are recorded?
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding?

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Home BP remains elevated above target (≥140/90 mmHg), suggesting suboptimal control on current lisinopril dose.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Review home BP log for pattern and consider titration or add-on therapy per guideline.

check_points.text: Check whether kidney function and potassium have been monitored after starting or changing lisinopril dose.

reference.quote: Check kidney function and potassium after starting or changing an ACE inhibitor dose.
